description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Twitch''' sends out a lethal toxin to each nearby enemy afflicted by ''[[File:Twitch Deadly Venom.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Deadly Venom|An icon for Twitch's ability Deadly Venom]] [[Twitch#Deadly Venom|Deadly Venom]]'', dealing them physical damage.
description.text: Active: Twitch sends out a lethal toxin to each nearby enemy afflicted by Deadly Venom, dealing them physical damage.

description2.raw: ''Contaminate'' deals additional physical damage and 35% AP magic damage for each stack of ''[[File:Twitch Deadly Venom.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Deadly Venom|An icon for Twitch's ability Deadly Venom]] [[Twitch#Deadly Venom|Deadly Venom]]'' on the target.
description2.text: Contaminate deals additional physical damage and 35% AP magic damage for each stack of Deadly Venom on the target.

description3.raw: ''A nearby enemy with [[File:Twitch Deadly Venom.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Deadly Venom|An icon for Twitch's ability Deadly Venom]] [[Twitch#Deadly Venom|Deadly Venom]] is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] to be targeted by this ability.''
description3.text: A nearby enemy with Deadly Venom is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be visible to be targeted by this ability.

notes.raw: * ''Contaminate'' will deal the additional damage to targets based on the number of [[File:Twitch Deadly Venom.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Deadly Venom|An icon for Twitch's ability Deadly Venom]] [[Twitch#Deadly Venom|Deadly Venom]] stacks they had at the start of the cast time. * '''Twitch''' is given a range indicator for ''Contaminate's'' radius upon infecting an enemy champion with [[File:Twitch Deadly Venom.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Deadly Venom|An icon for Twitch's ability Deadly Venom]] [[Twitch#Deadly Venom|Deadly Venom]] (actual range is slightly larger than shown by the indicator). * ''Contaminate'' will not deal damage to enemies that are not within range of the ability before the cast time completes. ** If the target moves out of range after the cast time, they are still dealt the damage.
notes.text:
Contaminate will deal the additional damage to targets based on the number of Deadly Venom stacks they had at the start of the cast time.
Twitch is given a range indicator for Contaminate's radius upon infecting an enemy champion with Deadly Venom (actual range is slightly larger than shown by the indicator).
Contaminate will not deal damage to enemies that are not within range of the ability before the cast time completes.
* If the target moves out of range after the cast time, they are still dealt the damage.
